name: Figurine of Wondrous Power (Marble Elephant)

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

powers.name: Animate
powers.text: Magic action: throw it to a spot within 60 ft: it becomes a Elephant for up to 24 hours, then can't be used again for 7 days.

summary: Becomes a Elephant that serves you for up to 24 hours (once every 7 days).
text: Small enough for a pocket, this statuette comes alive when you use a Magic action to hurl it at a spot on the ground up to 60 feet away, turning into an Elephant. If something already occupies that space, the transformation fails. The Elephant regards you and your allies as friends, knows your languages and does as you say; given no orders, it defends itself and otherwise does nothing. After up to 24 hours it becomes a figurine once more, or sooner if it is reduced to 0 Hit Points or you touch it and use a Magic action to end the transformation. Once it reverts, the figurine needs 7 days before it works again.
